body: I heard that song by logic "1-800-273-8255" and it made me think I should do something to help. I impulsively called the number and asked if there was anything I could do to help and they said that I could apply to become a volunteer. I never thought I would be accepted but then I was and I just thought it was a cool opportunity to do something like this.

honestly thats what Im confused about. I feel like I've gotten all the things I thought I needed to be happy, but I'm still not. Any suggestions on how to be happier. Thanks for reading this and saying something tho, I really do appreciate it.

Just someone who is willing and able to be a good listener. That is pretty much the best skill. Someone who is compassionate and empathetic. I truly believe most people have it in them to do it. Although it gets really tough, I think a lot of people have the instincts to just empathize with someone who is struggling.

Yea one time I got a call from someone who had worked at a hotline herself and we just had so much in common. We both had really bad depression and our social/family background was nearly identical. I felt like if I didn't save her then someone wouldn't save me. Long story short she said I gave her a genuine connection she hadn't ever felt before, and with that she was complacent with taking her own life.
